activities_external_identity_valid.name: activities_external_identity_valid
activities_external_identity_valid.value: ("activities"."origin" = 'local' and "activities"."external_source" is null and "activities"."external_id" is null) or ("activities"."origin" = 'external' and (("activities"."external_source" is null and "activities"."external_id" is null) or ("activities"."external_source" is not null and "activities"."external_id" is not null)))

schedule_slots_time_valid.name: schedule_slots_time_valid
schedule_slots_time_valid.value: "schedule_slots"."starts_at_minutes" between 0 and 1439 and "schedule_slots"."ends_at_minutes" between 1 and 1440 and "schedule_slots"."starts_at_minutes" < "schedule_slots"."ends_at_minutes"

schedule_slots_validity_order.name: schedule_slots_validity_order
schedule_slots_validity_order.value: "schedule_slots"."valid_from" is null or "schedule_slots"."valid_until" is null or "schedule_slots"."valid_from" <= "schedule_slots"."valid_until"
